data: Când s-a născut John, în 1934, mama sa i-a dat trei nume: John, Constantin şi Brâncuşi. I-a spus că tatăl său e faimosul sculptor Constantin Brâncuşi, dar că nu trebuie să spună nimănui acest lucru. John a ţinut secretul toată viaţa. Acum, la 78 de ani, începe dificila misiune de a-şi regăsi tatăl pierdut. (When John was born, in 1934, his mother gifted him with three names: John, Constantin and Brâncusi. She told him his father was Constantin Brâncusi, the famous sculptor.)

When John was born, in 1934, his mother gifted him with three names: John, Constantin and Brâncusi. She told him his father was Constantin Brâncusi, the famous sculptor.
